findings.what: Reminders are only sent while reminder_at is within ±5 min of now; a cron outage over 5 min or a booking made under 24h ahead means that reminder is never sent
Reassign doesn't check the target doctor's working days/hours or whether the appointment is already in the past
Staff override skips all checks, allowing bookings in the past or at arbitrary minutes
Rate limiter keeps counts in memory per process and keys on the spoofable x-forwarded-for header; reschedule actions have no rate limit
Custom schedule grid instead of the Schedule-X resource view named in PRD §8.1/F-S-001
Nothing ever sets an appointment to 'completed', so that status can't occur
